Chapter 1170 - 29: Xuanhuang (Seeking Subscription)_2

Chapter 1170: Chapter 29: Xuanhuang (Seeking Subscription)_2

Originally, one only needed to hand over the corresponding number of chaos stones to safely exchange back the main battle body.

But now? Who knows what further price needs to be paid.

...

"The two unparalleled Great Saints?"

The Dual Origin Great Saint, who had already reached another Void Domain, was slightly taken aback, then immediately felt a sense of relief.

"Galactic Great Saint, it seems I have to thank you."

The Dual Origin Great Saint thought to himself.

If it weren’t for the Galactic Great Saint, he would still be exploring within the Xuanhuang Universe at this moment.

At this time, with the entry of the two unparalleled Great Saints, what could his Dual Origin outcome be?

The Dual Origin Great Saint barely escaped from Lin Yuan’s grasp after a desperate fight.

But facing the unparalleled Great Saints? No matter how much he struggled for his life, he couldn’t escape.

By then, his fate would certainly be much worse than it is now.

...

"This Galactic Great Saint, to persist for so long in front of Hunxiao? Remarkable."

"I reckon Hunxiao was unwilling to pay the price and wanted to suppress the Galactic Great Saint without loss."

"Even so, it’s very rare, as the Galactic Great Saint doesn’t even possess the power of chaos evolution."

...

The broken blade, the ancient Altar Spirit, the Eye of Myriad Laws, and several other special beings were observing the situation within the Xuanhuang Universe.

At the level of an unparalleled Great Saint, the formation of an independent void world makes it impossible for these special beings to forcibly penetrate for observation.

But based on the faint time-space fluctuations transmitted, many things could be inferred.

These special beings have experienced one Cosmic Era after another, possessing keen vision and can deduce many conclusions from subtle hints.

At this moment.

The entire Xuanhuang Universe froze completely.

This freezing involved not only space but also time.

If the previous Xuanhuang Universe was a stream of flowing water.

Then at this moment, the Xuanhuang Universe had solidified from flowing water to a solid.

All power fluctuations and aura rules were completely silenced, unable to be transmitted in the slightest.

"What is this?"

The special beings like the broken blade and the ancient Altar Spirit suddenly had a change in expression, and a common thought surged in their hearts.

"Xuanhuang?"

...

A majestic and towering man stood in mid-air, without emitting any aura.

But since his appearance, inexplicable changes began in the Xuanhuang Universe. The grand road rules started boiling, and the rules initially oppressed by the Great Saint Hunxiao and Jade Qilin Great Saint rapidly counter-pressed.

Compared to the changes in the Xuanhuang Universe.

Great Saint Hunxiao and Jade Qilin Great Saint paid no attention. The gazes of the two unparalleled Great Saints were fixed on the majestic and towering man, as if witnessing an unbelievable scene, like the sudden appearance of someone who absolutely should not have appeared.

"Xuanhuang?"

"Weren’t you advancing to the Thirteen-stage?"

Great Saint Hunxiao was on high alert, his voice trembling.

He was certain that the majestic and towering man before him was not some kind of imprint consciousness but Xuanhuang himself, the Invincible Great Saint who, over thirty million Cosmic Eras ago, had the power to sweep away other unparalleled Great Saints.

Back when Xuanhuang was advancing towards the Thirteen-stage, to eliminate potential threats, he specifically hunted down a batch of unparalleled Great Saints, among whom were Hunxiao and Jade Qilin.

In the end, Hunxiao and Jade Qilin, being left with no choice, opted for reincarnation to escape Xuanhuang’s hunt.

The Chaos Realm allows for reincarnation, and a Great Saint who achieves perfection in the Chaos Realm can retain some memories post-reincarnation, with an unparalleled Great Saint retaining even more.

However.

Even if all memories are retained, what of it? After reincarnation, it is the weakest period for any Great Saint; if reincarnated into a strong species, it’s still manageable, but if reincarnated into a fragile species, it becomes perilous.

Reincarnation in the Chaos Realm, whether for ordinary beings or unparalleled Great Saints, is random, leaving no choice in the reincarnation target.

In the boundless Chaos Void, primordial universes, secret realms, and the weak, fragile species make up ninety-nine percent, with the strong species being few.

This means that unless unbelievably lucky, even an unparalleled Great Saint is likely to reincarnate into a low starting point.

With such a low start, even possessing partial memory, survival is still difficult if trapped in a desperate and perilous situation.

Once the reincarnated body dies, a second reincarnation will occur, and the memories retained during the second reincarnation will become negligible, making the hope of returning as a Great Saint even more remote.

At the Chaos Great Saint level, especially the Absolute Great Saints, their paths are vast and profound, holding hope of becoming a Time Life. If not absolutely necessary, they would never choose reincarnation.

"Have you crossed into the Thirteenth Layer?"

Beside him, Jade Qilin Great Saint was shaken. The first thought in his mind when he heard Xuanhuang slipped out of the time loop was that he had crossed into the Thirteenth Layer.

"No."

"You have not crossed into the Thirteenth Layer. The birth of every Time Life causes a vibration in the space-time layer of the Chaos Void, and we will certainly become aware of it."

Jade Qilin Great Saint felt an immense terror in his heart, but still managed to maintain basic rationality.

For life in the Chaos Void, when crossing from the eleventh to the twelfth layer, they will endure the infusion of the Chaos Void Origin.

And when crossing from the twelfth to the thirteenth layer, it is the same, but the shock caused far exceeds the former.

"Right, you have not crossed into the Thirteenth Layer."

Great Saint Hunxiao also realized, and they looked at the majestic and formidable man not far away. For over thirty million Cosmic Eras, this man has become their Heart Demon.

The two Absolute Great Saints dared not challenge the Thirteenth Layer, and they sought to erase the traces of the Profound Xuanhuang lineage to minimize the Heart Demon’s influence on them.

"So many Cosmic Eras have passed, and you two wastes have still not changed."

The majestic and great man smiled and muttered to himself.

...

"Xuanhuang?"

Lin Yuan also looked at the majestic and great man beside him, his heart rippling.

Xuanhuang?

Is that Xuanhuang?

The founder of the Profound Xuanhuang lineage?

Even though not an Invincible Great Saint, yet not the slightest bit weaker than an Invincible Great Saint’s Absolute Great Saint?

Lin Yuan was filled with countless thoughts. Since stepping into the Ninth Layer and entering the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, he had heard of this Sovereign Xuanhuang, and in the universe of his homeland, the legacy of the Profound Xuanhuang line had played a significant role for him.

And now, has he actually met the true Sovereign Xuanhuang?

"Crushing that bead will summon Sovereign Xuanhuang?"

Lin Yuan’s thoughts surged, but a greater doubt arose in his heart—

If so, why did the Tomb Spirit advise him as much as possible not to crush it?

...

Great Saint Hunxiao and Jade Qilin Great Saint’s expressions were gloomy. Though still terrified, when they heard Xuanhuang refer to them as ’waste,’ their eyes clouded as if they returned to over thirty million Cosmic Eras ago.

At that time, they were also Absolute Great Saints, supposedly dominating the Chaos Void, ultimately consolidating everything to impact the Thirteenth Layer.

But in that era, Xuanhuang, this monster, was born, who was born nothing more than an ant-like life nurtured by the natural universe.

In terms of inheritance, Xuanhuang had no elders to rely on.

Yet this ant quickly grew to the Chaos Realm, Chaos Realm Perfection, Absolute Great Saint!

Great Saint Hunxiao, Jade Qilin Great Saint, and many other Absolute Great Saints of that era basically lived under Xuanhuang’s shadow.

"Xuanhuang, over thirty million Cosmic Eras have passed, Jade Qilin and I underwent one reincarnation, returning to the peak, much stronger than before."

Great Saint Hunxiao’s voice grew louder, resonating across space-time.

Jade Qilin Great Saint was the same, his eyes quickly calmed down.

"Is that so?"

The majestic great man smiled slightly, then lifted his right hand behind him.

"Escape!"

Great Saint Hunxiao and Jade Qilin Great Saint, like startled birds, fled towards the entrance without hesitation. At this moment, Xuanhuang Universe integrated into one, they could not tear the surrounding space-time, and only hope of escape lay at the entrance.

...

Inner Universe.

Inside the tomb, the Tomb Spirit sat there, looking downcast, softly whispering: "Your Majesty."

"Even though thirty million Cosmic Eras can’t break through the time cycle, the hope of stepping into the Thirteenth Layer will be very slim, but however slim, it is still hope, and in the distant future, there might be changes."

"Even without changes, but falling into the time cycle, you are still alive. As long as you are alive, there is hope, there is hope!"

The eyes of the Tomb Spirit lowered, faint crystal tears rolled down.

"But why give up this hope, why give up?"

The Tomb Spirit’s body trembled violently.
